events.factual_description: Billboard Live Tokyo presents Ginji Ito on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 for two sets at 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM in a pre-55th-anniversary program with Masamichi Sugi and EPO. Billboard describes Ito as an artist, producer and arranger whose work has shaped Japanese pop, notes that he and Sugi met through Eiichi Ohtaki and the Niagara label and have collaborated repeatedly, and highlights Ito's long connection with EPO beginning with her debut song DOWN TOWN, for which Ito wrote lyrics. The announced seven-person band is Ginji Ito, Masamichi Sugi, EPO, Tatsuya Ono, Fukuju Matsushita, Naohiro Goya and Yumika Mori. Billboard also lists a related Osaka performance on August 24.

en.why_it_matters: The draw is not a generic city-pop nostalgia bill. Ito, Sugi and EPO sit inside overlapping strands of Japanese pop songwriting that run through Eiichi Ohtaki, Niagara and the late-1970s/1980s studio culture that later listeners rediscovered under broader city-pop labels. Putting the three together just before Ito's 55th anniversary turns those connections into the subject of the night: songwriter history, shared repertoire memory and vocal/guitar interplay rather than a museum-style retrospective.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the two sets if Tokyo dates line up and the history of Japanese pop songwriting is part of the listening thread. The same anniversary concept also appears in Osaka two days earlier, so there is useful flexibility rather than true one-night scarcity.

es.why_it_matters: El atractivo no es un cartel genérico de nostalgia city pop. Ito, Sugi y EPO viven dentro de varias líneas que se cruzan en la historia de la composición pop japonesa: Eiichi Ohtaki, Niagara y esa cultura de estudio de finales de los setenta y los ochenta que décadas después muchos oyentes redescubrieron bajo etiquetas más amplias de city pop. Juntarlos justo antes de los 55 años de carrera de Ito convierte esas conexiones en el tema de la noche: historia de canciones, memoria compartida de repertorio y diálogo de voces y guitarras, no una retrospectiva de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Sí vale hacerle espacio activamente a uno de los dos sets si las fechas en Tokio cuadran y la historia de la composición pop japonesa forma parte del hilo de escucha. El mismo concepto de aniversario pasa por Osaka dos días antes, así que existe flexibilidad útil y no una escasez real de una sola noche.
